notes: This contract records the portable C++ TCK check for the official IEEE 1516.1 available time-advance services at the inclusive GALT boundary. The source uses only the standard C++ RTIambassador and FederateAmbassador APIs plus the standard library; the adapter supplies the provider package, FOM, endpoint, callback configuration, and logical-time implementation. It verifies timestamped interaction delivery through Time Advance Request Available and Next Message Request Available, boundary ordering, retraction metadata, and grant servicing without asserting provider-specific names, registries, headers, or implementation behavior. The §8.11.3 mapping covers only the sender-side rule that a zero-lookahead federate may submit a new message timestamped T after receiving a grant to T: the test sets lookahead to zero, receives TAR(9)'s grant, and checks sendInteraction at timestamp 9 is accepted. It makes no claim about when that message is delivered. The page-198 statement that all equal-time messages are not guaranteed before a grant is a non-guarantee, not a required outcome; that incomplete candidate remains unmapped under RL-386.

api_surfaces.signature: RTIambassador available time-advance services, lookahead control, timestamped interaction submission, and FederateAmbassador grant callbacks
